question: What is the chemical name of baking soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium hydrogen carbonate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• **Baking soda is a commonly used household chemical compound that is also known as sodium bicarbonate or sodium hydrogen carbonate**.
 
• The chemical formula of baking soda is** NaHCO₃**, which indicates that it consists of **sodium (Na), hydrogen (H), carbon (C), and oxygen (O) atoms.**
